<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<testsuite name="load:fail" tests="3" failures="2" time="<varies>">
  <properties>
    <property name="runId" value="<uuid>"/>
    <property name="state" value="COMPLETED"/>
    <property name="verdict" value="FAIL"/>
    <property name="requestsSent" value="2"/>
    <property name="succeeded" value="2"/>
    <property name="failed" value="0"/>
    <property name="droppedIterations" value="0"/>
    <property name="errorRate" value="0.0"/>
    <property name="p50Millis" value="<varies>"/>
    <property name="p95Millis" value="<varies>"/>
    <property name="p99Millis" value="<varies>"/>
    <property name="p999Millis" value="<varies>"/>
  </properties>
  <testcase name="threshold: ERROR_RATE LESS_THAN 0">
    <failure message="observed <varies> LESS_THAN 0 not satisfied"/>
  </testcase>
  <testcase name="threshold: THROUGHPUT_RPS GREATER_THAN <varies>">
  </testcase>
  <testcase name="run completed">
    <failure message="run finished with a FAIL threshold verdict"/>
    <system-out>requestsSent=2 succeeded=2 failed=0 errorRate=0 p95Millis=<varies> p99Millis=<varies></system-out>
  </testcase>
</testsuite>
